display.purpose: Page headlines and status-headline moments only -- Bricolage Grotesque 800, never body copy or UI chrome.

body.purpose: All functional text: descriptions, forms, nav, buttons, metadata -- Plus Jakarta Sans.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Quietest resting elevation, rarely used alone.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Default depth for buttons and surfaces that carry some rest-state shadow (price-slider thumb).

motion.name: ease-confident
motion.purpose: Interaction feedback -- card hover lift, photo zoom, filter/page-btn hover, confident deceleration with no overshoot.

motion.name: ease-entrance
motion.purpose: Authored entrance animations -- card stagger-in, modal drop-in (.menu-drop), bar fill, save-confirm pill.

motion.name: duration-immediate
motion.purpose: Icon buttons, links, filter controls, CTA hover -- direct feedback to a click or hover.

motion.name: duration-photo
motion.purpose: Restaurant card photo hover-zoom -- tuned to move together with the card's own 180ms lift.

components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: Flat olive pill CTA -- distinct from the amber accent used everywhere else; shadow and lift are earned on hover only.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--cta-bg, #55503a); color: var(--cta-text, #f3ece0); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0 24px; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 100ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cta-bg-hover, #413d2c); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(36,31,24,0.09); transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.03); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c98a1f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Pill (toggle)
components.description: Toggle-style control (e.g. 'All restaurants' / 'For You'); active state fills with the amber accent, inactive sits on subtle sand.
components.css: .ds-filter-pill { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-filter-pill.ds-is-active { background: var(--accent, #c98a1f); color: #241f18; border-color: var(--accent, #c98a1f); } .ds-filter-pill.ds-is-active:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #ab7319); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #ab7319); } .ds-filter-pill:not(.ds-is-active) { background: var(--bg-subtle, #efe6d3); color: var(--text-secondary, #5c5346); border-color: var(--border, rgba(36,31,24,0.1)); } .ds-filter-pill:not(.ds-is-active):hover { background: var(--bg-inset, #e6dabf); border-color: var(--border-strong, rgba(36,31,24,0.18)); color: var(--text, #241f18); }

components.name: Restaurant Card
components.description: Photography-first card: flat at rest, lifts with --shadow-card-hover and a subtle photo zoom on hover/in-view.
components.html:
Restaurant Name

Neighborhood · Cuisine · $$
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--bg-card, #fffdf8); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(36,31,24,0.1)); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 20px 48px rgba(36,31,24,0.22); } .ds-card-photo-wrap { overflow: hidden; height: 200px; } .ds-card-photo { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-photo { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--text, #241f18); margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-meta { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-secondary, #5c5346); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Warm-sand field with an amber focus ring, no default browser outline.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--bg-subtle, #efe6d3); color: var(--text, #241f18); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(36,31,24,0.1)); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #c98a1f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(201,138,31,0.12); }

components.name: Site Header
components.description: Sticky nav; active page carries weight and color, never an underline or pill mark.
components.html:
Locals
RecsSavedVisitedAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 24px; background: var(--bg, #f7f1e5); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(36,31,24,0.1)); position: sticky; top: 0; } .ds-nav-logo { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--text, #241f18); } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; } .ds-nav-link { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-secondary, #5c5346); text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-nav-link-active { font-weight: 500; color: var(--text, #241f18); }

components.name: Modal / Flow Overlay
components.description: Shared construction for every modal in the app (rating flow, sign-in prompt, Find People, Follow List) -- portal-rendered, one authored entrance keyframe (.menu-drop).
components.css: .ds-modal-backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px; } .ds-modal-card { width: 100%; max-width: 24rem; background: var(--bg-card, #fffdf8); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(36,31,24,0.14); animation: ds-menu-drop 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1) both; transform-origin: top right; } @keyframes ds-menu-drop { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px) scale(0.97); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } } .ds-modal-title { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; color: var(--text, #241f18); margin-bottom: 20px; }

narrative.overview: Locals is built around the feeling of the seat a regular always gets at their neighborhood spot -- warm, familiar, quietly earned rather than announced. The system leans editorial (The Infatuation, Eater) over platform-generic: photography carries the argument, type sets the tone, and chrome stays out of the way. Every trust signal on the page -- an archetype badge, a localness bar, a "locals rate it 4.4 vs. tourists' 3.8" verdict -- is treated as something earned through a real, inspectable rule, never applied as decoration. The site-wide palette is warm amber-and-cream, with a separate, deliberately muted olive reserved for the one primary call-to-action -- a correction from an earlier bright-accent CTA that read as a pop-up ad. It explicitly rejects Yelp/TripAdvisor registers: no gradient text, no glassmorphism, no badges that don't mean something specific. Depth is used sparingly and only in response to interaction -- flat by default, lifting only when someone is actually engaging with it. One surface breaks from this system on purpose: the homepage hero runs its own "24-hour diner counter" visual world, documented separately as a scoped exception, not a system-wide change.
keyCharacteristics: Photography-first card grid; the food photo is the hero, the UI frames it
Warm amber/cream site-wide palette, with a distinct muted-olive CTA color reserved for the one primary action
Bricolage Grotesque (display, 700/800) paired with Plus Jakarta Sans (body) -- a bold geometric sans pairing, not a serif
Shape language is mixed, not absolute: full pills for buttons/tags/avatars; rounded-xl/2xl rectangles for cards and modals -- both native
Flat-at-rest surfaces that gain shadow and lift only on hover/interaction
Every badge, score, and verdict traces back to a real computed rule, never decoration

rules.name: The CTA-Is-Not-The-Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary call-to-action button uses its own dedicated olive, never the amber accent color -- the two are visually and semantically distinct roles, confirmed by the code's own comment after an earlier bright-amber CTA was rejected.

rules.name: The Dark-Mode Warmth Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is not a desaturated inversion -- every warm hue shifts brighter and more saturated (amber #c98a1f -> #e0a73a) to stay warm under low light rather than going cold and gray.

rules.name: The Display-Is-Rare Rule
rules.body: Bricolage Grotesque at 800 weight is reserved for a page's own headline moment -- it does not appear in buttons, metadata, form fields, or routine section labels.

rules.name: The Earned Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadow only appears in response to state -- hover, scroll-into-view, an open dropdown. A surface that shows --shadow-card-hover or --shadow-lg whether or not anyone is touching it is a mistake, not a stylistic choice.

rules.name: The Role-Based Radius Rule
rules.body: Radius is assigned by what a shape is, not by one blanket invariant: an action a person taps is a full pill; a container that holds content is a rounded rectangle at 8-16px. Both forms are native to the shipped system.

dos: Do keep the photo as the largest, first thing a person sees on any card or detail page.

Do use the full pill radius (9999px) for buttons, tags, chips, and avatars; use 8-16px for rectangular containers (cards, modals, inputs) -- both are native, pick by component role, not by a single rule.
Do let shadow and lift communicate interactivity -- apply --shadow-card-hover/--shadow-lg only on hover/active/in-view states, never at rest.
Do back every badge, score, or "verdict" sentence with a real, recomputable rule against the live dataset.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling transform/transition/animation app-wide.
Do keep the primary CTA's color (olive) distinct from the amber accent used everywhere else.
donts: Don't use gradient text for emphasis -- weight and size carry emphasis in this system.
Don't give a CTA button a gradient or a shadow at rest -- the earlier gradient-plus-shadow CTA read as a pop-up ad, not an app action.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing on any transition; motion decelerates confidently and never overshoots.
Don't show an archetype badge, "verified," or trust indicator that isn't backed by an inspectable rule.

Don't reuse the homepage hero's amber-glow/orange-neon diner-counter treatment, Fredoka/Space Grotesk fonts, or checkerboard-floor motif anywhere outside that one surface -- it is a scoped exception, not a system-wide addition.
